messages:
Nora: Huge shoutout to eng-sre, eng-infra, devex, and customer-success for jumping in on the Zephyr demo today. Demo would have been 🚨 without you.
Liam: Rolled a hotfix + rollback on the model variant in ~15m. Thanks everyone who stayed late :sweat_smile:
Zara: Priya and Alex pairing FTW. Also ops-barista delivered oat lattes to the war room ☕️:clap:
Ben: Customer called it out as "seamless" — they loved the fallback behavior. :star_struck:
Alex: Pasted the rollback command we used so folks can reuse it:
```
./rollback.sh --release=zephyr-v2 --force
```
Priya: Support's reproduction steps were gold — saved us time getting root cause. Huge props to Maya for the prompt tests.
Maya: Happy to run the prompt regression sweep. Found a tokenization edge-case that caused the rerank mismatch.
Chris: I'll ping sales and execs with a quick note. Also, cookies in the kitchen for the late crew 🍪
Liam: Adding to that — writing a short postmortem + checklist for canarying model variants (will link in #eng-releases).
deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered by policy `latency-spike-automated` at 21:07 UTC
Nora: Love this cross-team hustle. If anyone wants a small token, DM me and I'll forward names to people-ops.
Zara: Sent my list. Thank you all!! :raised_hands:
Ethan: This is exactly why I joined Redwood — teamwork and snacks. :heart:
